title: JustFleshToLeather
description: this plugin makes it so you can smelt rotten flesh to leather
body:
# Simple Rotten Flesh to Leather
**Tired of having chests full of useless Rotten Flesh?** This lightweight and performance-friendly plugin adds a simple but essential mechanic to your Minecraft server: **Smelting Rotten Flesh into Leather.**

Whether you are running a survival world, a hardcore server, or a massive multiplayer network, this plugin provides a balanced way to obtain leather without constantly hunting cows.

## **🛠 Features:**
- **Multi-Station Support:** Works with standard **Furnaces**, **Smokers**, and **Campfires**.

- **Balanced Gameplay:** Each station has its own realistic cooking time and provides a small amount of experience (XP) upon completion.

- **Optimized Code:** Extremely lightweight with zero impact on server performance (no lag).

- **Plug & Play:** No configuration needed. Just drop the JAR into your plugins folder and you are ready to go!

## **⏲ Cooking Times:**
- **Furnace:** 10 seconds (Standard)

- **Smoker:** 5 seconds (Fast)

- **Campfire:** 30 seconds (Slow but multi-slot)

### **💻 Compatibility:**
- **Versions:** Supports Minecraft 1.16.x up to the latest 1.21.x versions.

- **Software:** Fully compatible with Paper, Spigot, Purpur, and Pufferfish.
